articles.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president and is reviewing whether Kalshi followed policy.

articles.title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
articles.snippet: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.

articles.title: 'Doomed From the Start': President Trump's Meme Coin Hits New Lows After Midterms
articles.snippet: The TRUMP token has fallen almost 40% since election day, with analysts pointing to the Democrats’ subpoena plans, fading interest, and a heavy unlock schedule.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Not Considering Jensen Huang's Return: Report
articles.snippet: The board is focused on its probe into the ousted co-founder, a source told CNBC, despite Donald Trump and Elon Musk backing his return.
